families.note: Reuses existing device discovery contracts; no additional provider operation is invented.

verification.limitations: Offline source identity, document structure and pattern checks; not complete country/hardware/UI execution proof. All writes, unavailable native setters and dependent physical workflows remain Draft gates.
verification.manualReview: Reviewed all seven supplied screenshots, native representative device/settings/routine/comfort/maintenance/battery screens, selected public contracts, current HA registry code and explicit unknowns. No raw traffic or household values included.

findings.fact: The app list includes all physical device families; current HA code groups cameras under the entry hub. Complete physical registration is specified separately.
Provider alias and HA user naming are separate; names are not stable identity.
Partial day and partial night can both be selected. Total was fixed; observed perimeter participation was not editable.
Per-sensor chime and panel bell prerequisite differ; filtered and full lists have different scopes; action buttons alone do not prove current enabled state.
SSID/password/security form remained available after location permission was declined. QR was visible but not invoked; no network change was submitted.
Device-list and general-system entries both offer timing configuration; expose a common domain capability, with panel-specific contracts and no duplicate polling.
Observed comfort UI showed weather and presentation preferences; no indoor telemetry source was established.
Maintenance page opened without an editable visit; booking changes and technician notification delivery were not exercised.
Routine and reminder creation forms and failure-only notification preference were viewed without submitting; the preference setter is not in the initial recovered operation inventory.
DIY landing displayed no eligible events; process steps were not started. DIYInit and DIYCheck are mutations in inspected source.

configurationFollowUp.nativeTrafficCapture: No new HAR; UI observations and static contracts remain separate from verified HTTP execution.
